name: Jasuko
source:
A slightly annoying and cute Cosmic Wraith who wears a skirt resembling a UFO saucer.

When she returned to the solar system from her part-time job, Jasuko's employers had been destroyed, leaving her unemployed. She is surprisingly cheerful and has a habit of adding "desu" to the end of her sentences.

Her ray gun "Chrolla Bell" is an all-purpose device that can do just about anything.

At first glance, her body appears comparable to a human but that's as far as things go. She has a "7-colored vagina". She can change the pressure and feel of her vagina at will. tightening at different points, vice like tightness, changes in bumpiness, wrapping around a penis like an octopus, the list goes on. Any combination of these techniques let her adapt to the needs of her partner and bring untold pleasure to him.
